name: Deep Harbor
intent: Third level with hidden containers, and the hardest of the three. Eight colours across four boards, and the octopus is the puzzle: its purple body is 102 pixels buried under the pink tentacles, the white suckers and the black eyes, so almost half the level's biggest board waits on a colour that only clears from underneath. Purple is shared with the tropical fish's head so there is somewhere safe to start it; white runs through the octopus, the swan and the life ring, so a white container is never wasted. Black is only the octopus's four eye pixels, deep inside the body, so its one small container is the level's planned clog and must come late. Two hidden containers.
